item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
During a school lunch break, Meena from Tamil Nadu brought lemon rice, Arjun from Punjab brought parathas with curd, and Kuki from Assam brought steamed rice with dal. Their teacher asked why children from different states eat such different traditional foods. Which of the following explanations is correct? ( )
A. Every state grows exactly the same crops, so their foods differ only because of cooking vessels
B. Traditional foods differ because they are based on locally grown crops along with taste preferences, culture and traditions of each region
C. A state's traditional foods decide which crops can grow in that state
D. Everyone in a state eats one fixed traditional food, so differences are only between states

options.A: Every state grows exactly the same crops, so their foods differ only because of cooking vessels
options.B: Traditional foods differ because they are based on locally grown crops along with taste preferences, culture and traditions of each region
options.C: A state's traditional foods decide which crops can grow in that state
options.D: Everyone in a state eats one fixed traditional food, so differences are only between states
